title: He has plenty of Saturdays, it whispered… #Shorts
description:
Grandpa asked him to go fishing on Saturday, like old times. The thing in his window said there would be plenty more Saturdays. Then Christmas, the hospital, the call he declined… and every Saturday was gone.
